protocol.description: Declared engineering comparison after adaptive pilots; exact streaming vs unchanged packed-integer kernel. All outcomes retained.
protocol.interpretation: Original 100M work / 20 s boundary is retained separately. Extended 16r comparison gives both kernels 300M work / 60 s; 400M original-kernel row is an exact-value reference only. No performance superiority over Aer is assumed.

queries.parity: expectation of Z on every site

protocol.timing: Sequential fresh single-thread worker per row; execution includes native contraction imports and excludes circuit/setup imports as in stress_benchmark. RSS includes setup. Three repeats for primary 12r parity and extended 16r local; other rows one run.
